name: MVCC Transactional Key-Value Store
description: Repair snapshot-isolated reads, first-committer-wins conflict validation with per-key write locks, single commit stamps, predecessor closure, and GC pinned by open snapshots.
planted_defect: commit performs no conflict check and takes no locks
each write stamped with its own timestamp
version chain appends oldest-first and never closes predecessors
GC drops versions still visible to the oldest open snapshot
